title: Fast Leaves
description: Consistent fast leaves, with waterlog visibility.
body:
![Comparison of Waterlogged Leaves (Vanilla/Pack)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5423a9713e7f880285d71c9e390726b4e4effef.png)

A small resource pack that improves the fast leaves setting.

## Features

**Consistency**  
When holding a leaf block, the texture matches the placed block.

**Visibility**  
Waterlogged leaves have a separate, distinct texture.

**Vanilla-friendly**  
No mods required — all changes stay true to the vanilla aesthetic.

## Why does this pack exist?

> Even though Mojang improved the fast leaves texture and renamed the setting to "See-Through Leaves" in version 1.21.11, it is still impossible to tell if a leaf block is waterlogged. The main bug report addressing this, **[MC-249486](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-249486)**, was closed as "Works As Intended" in 2023.

Icon inspired by **[Oculie](https://modrinth.com/user/Oculie)**.
